title: Instrumentation and Articulation in Film Scores

flashcard_questions.q: A large group of musicians playing together, typically divided into strings, woodwind, brass and percussion families.
The way a note is played, such as smoothly (legato), sharply (staccato), or with emphasis (accent).
The quality or colour of a sound that makes one instrument sound different from another.

flashcard_questions.a: A string player bows two strings at once, sounding two notes together.
A string technique where the player plucks the string with their finger instead of using the bow.
